title: Abbas ke lashe pa bayaa karte the sarwar
body:
abbas ke laashe pe baya'n karte the sarwar
shabbir ka ab koi nahi monis o yawar
poochhe jo sakina mere ammu ko huwa kya
kaise kahu'n ke so gaye baazu ko kata kar
<<DIVIDER>>
kya qalb pe zainab ke guzar jayegi bhayya
jab khoon me tar mashk o alam dekhegi khwahar
akber hai na qasim hai na ab aun o mohd
shabbir pe jaa'n apni fida kar gaye asgher
<<DIVIDER>>
maotal me jo tanha mujhe dekhegi wo dukhiya
abbas tumhe degi sada zainb e muztar
ab khole huwe baal nazar aayegi amma
naize pe nazar aayega bhai ka mere sar
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki duwa parcham e saqqa-e-haram hai
matam isi parcham tale ab hoga baradar
sahil pe tadap jayega abbas ka laasha
zainab jo kahegi mere bhayya meri chadar
